messages:
marta: heads up — console started hitting 30s timeouts when launching large telemetry recompute backfills this morning. dashboard gets stuck on "estimating" then 502s. anyone on-call?

liam: i'm looking. traffic spikes from the reprocess job queue, lots of preflight calls to /recompute/estimate

sree: confirm. telemetry ingest team rolled a shard split yesterday, the estimate job now touches ~200k keys. preflight TTL=10s is too aggressive for that cardinality.

alex: can we short-circuit console to show a "preview-only" (sample 1%) to unblock UX? we don't need full estimate for the rollout, just a rough cost and latency.

marta: short-term: toggle preview in console -> sample param. long-term: quota-aware preflight routing so estimates go to a lightweight cluster.

jin: deploy-bot: reprocess-job-1823 started by ops at 08:12 UTC (job id 1823)

liam: log snippet from estimate service:
```
ERROR 2026-03-21 08:13:02 estimate_service timeout waiting for 200k keys
rpc timeout after 9.8s
```

sree: routing policy currently sends estimate requests to the primary compute group (optimized for full runs). we should route preflight/preview to a "preview" pool with smaller mem but better p99 latency.

alex: agree. also surface queue length + target cluster in the console so PMs know it's a preview vs full estimate. add an "estimate mode" badge and small explain copy.

marta: ops — can you cancel or throttle the heavy backfill? it's impacting customer-facing dashboards.

jin: ops on it. throttling job 1823 concurrency to 1 and pausing shard 7. will update in ~2m.

liam: proposed API change (short): add query param `?mode=preview|full` to `POST /recompute/estimate` and route based on mode. default=full. need eng-platform + telemetry signoff.

sree: also consider an approximate "cost-bound" estimate that returns a quick scalar + confidence score (useful for preview).

alex: UX note: for rollouts prefer `preview` by default for windows >6h to reduce friction and avoid blocking.

marta: next steps: liam -> PR for param + routing; sree -> tag preview pool + routing rule; alex -> wire badge & fallback copy; jin -> throttle current job. check-in in 30m.

liam: i'll open the PR and reference this thread, cc @sree @alex.

jin: throttled. job 1823 now concurrency=1, shard 7 paused. deploy-bot: job 1823 state=throttled

marta: confirmed dashboards are responsive again. thanks team :tada:

alex: follow-up idea — add a small "estimate sample" toggle in the console dropdown so users can opt-in to full estimate when they need it (and see expected wait).

sree: FYI i'll add telemetry metrics for estimate_count by mode + p99 latency so we can alert on preview->full regression.

marta: perfect. closing this huddle — we'll verify after PR lands.
